svg.text: Figure 2. Proposed Badminton Video Analysis Workflow
Dual-branch perception, court-plane projection, quality screening, and visual analytics
Verified local data: 9 videos | 4247 frames | 150.68 s | all Green | quality 88.96-95.96 (mean 93.81) | shuttle visible 69.19% | player distance 714.72 m | max speed 9.46 m/s
Fig. 2. Overview of the proposed workflow. The video stream is processed by a shuttle trajectory branch and a player motion branch; court priors project
observations onto a metric court plane, after which quality-controlled evidence is exported as videos, tables, reports, and an interactive dashboard.
